items.title: Julius Handy Interview, 1973-05-09
items.q: I played Joe Gordon. I played with him with Papa Celestine.

ctx.x: Yes. And so, but behind, so much grief in between. You know what I mean? It just knocks the spirit out of me. Then when I get out there, it's going to come back anyway. So I say. When was the last time you played?
Other than the other night. I played Joe Gordon. I played with him with Papa Celestine.
I mean Papa French. We played a job for him out of Madrid. And we had a nice time out there. It was wonderful. What year was that? That was, uh, that was about a month ago or two months ago.
